headline: European Defense Spending Surge Opens New Markets for German Machinery Firms
summary: A VDMA survey shows 43% of German machinery companies active in security and defense expect their revenues from those sectors to at least double by 2030 amid rising European defense budgets.
why: German machinery manufacturers are core suppliers to European industrial and defense supply chains.

impacts.name: German machinery sector
impacts.why: Survey indicates strong expected revenue growth driven by rising defense spending.
